rows.src: Agenda, Development, Planning and Sustainability Committee, October 27, 2026

rows.title: AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE Authorizing the purchase by one or more requirement contracts of signal support poles and installation, if necessary, for the Division of Traffic Engineering, Department of Public Works, for a period not to exceed two years; and to repeal Ordinance No. 1446-2025, passed November 24, 2025, relating to a public improvement by requirement contract for the purchase, repair, and installation of signal support poles.
rows.src: Agenda, Municipal Services and Properties Committee, October 26, 2026

rows.title: AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE Authorizing the Director of Public Works to enter into one or more contracts without competitive bidding with Sutphen Corporation, to provide repair and maintenance services to a fire truck currently under warranty with Sutphen Corporation, for the Division of Motor Vehicle Maintenance, Department of Public Works.
rows.src: Agenda, Municipal Services and Properties Committee, October 26, 2026

rows.title: AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE Authorizing the Director of Public Works to enter into an agreement with Road Worthy, Inc., for the Vehicle Lifecycle Workforce Development Initiative by donating City fleet vehicles, for a period of three years.
rows.src: Agenda, Municipal Services and Properties Committee, October 26, 2026

rows.title: AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE  Authorizing the Director of Capital Projects to apply to the District One Public Works Integrating Committee for state funding to resurface State Road from Burger Avenue to Hillcrest Avenue and authorizing the Director of Finance, or appropriate director, to accept the funding from the Ohio Public Works Commission; giving consent of the City of Cleveland to the Director of Transportation of the State of Ohio to construct the improvement; authorizing agreements; and causing payment to the State for the City’s share of the improvement.
rows.src: Agenda, Municipal Services and Properties Committee, October 26, 2026

rows.title: AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE Giving consent of the City of Cleveland to the Director of Transportation of the State of Ohio to resurface Shaker Boulevard from Buckeye Road to the east corporation line in the City of Cleveland; authorizing agreements; and causing payment to the State for the City’s share of the improvement.
rows.src: Agenda, Municipal Services and Properties Committee, October 26, 2026

rows.title: AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE Authorizing the Director of Capital Projects to enter into one or more agreements with the cities of Brook Park and Parma to resurface a portion of Brookpark Road located in the City of Cleveland; giving consent of the City of Cleveland to the Director of Transportation of the State of Ohio for the improvement; authorizing agreements; and authorizing payment to the City of Brook Park for the City of Cleveland’s portion of the improvement.
rows.src: Agenda, Municipal Services and Properties Committee, October 26, 2026

rows.title: AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE Authorizing the Mayor and/or the appropriate director to enter into a Host Agreement with The Los Angeles Organizing Committee for the Olympic and Paralympic Games 2028 (“LA28”), and one or more agreements with a local organizing committee and/or sponsor(s), and other entities for the City to host the torch relay through a portion of the City of Cleveland through the State of Ohio.
rows.src: Agenda, Municipal Services and Properties Committee, October 26, 2026

rows.title: AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE To amend Sections 551.01 through Sections 551.08, 551.111, 551.191, 551.26, 551.33 and 551.991 of the Codified Ordinances of Cleveland, Ohio, 1976, as amended by various ordinances, relating to waste collection and disposal citations.
rows.src: Agenda, Municipal Services and Properties Committee, October 26, 2026
